in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Will comes from the Hebrew word יִוֹל (yiwol), which means 'desire, wish.' This name can be given to a child as a sign of hope and aspiration for their future.

in_greek.name: Ἵλλος
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Will is derived from the word Ἵλλος (hēllos), which means 'handsome, good-looking.' This name was given to children as a symbol of beauty and grace.

in_latin.name: William
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Will is derived from the elements 'wil' meaning 'will' and 'helm' meaning 'helmet,' resulting in the name William. This name emphasizes the idea of strength, determination, and protection.
